about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Second Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that having received the grace of Thy life-giving power, we may ever glory in Thy gift. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
